display.purpose: Hero and section headings in English.

display-ar.purpose: Hero and section headings in Arabic.

body.purpose: All running text and UI in both scripts.

shadows.name: pinned
shadows.purpose: Paper pinned to the board at rest.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Paper picked up on hover, focus or selection.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All transitions: pin-in, lift, picked, language swap.

motion.name: pin-in
motion.purpose: Board specimens settle onto their pins on load; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The buy action and main calls to action, on walnut.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6rem; min-height:48px; padding:.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius:4px; background:#c49652; color:#160f0b; font:500 1.0625rem/1 'Readex Pro Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25) inset, 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .6); transition:background-color .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#d9b272; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Pill naming the other language in that language.
components.css: .ds-lang { display:inline-flex; padding:.45rem .95rem; border:1px solid rgb(196 150 82 / .55); border-radius:999px; color:#e6cfa2; text-decoration:none; font:450 .95rem/1.4 'Readex Pro Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-lang:hover { background:rgb(196 150 82 / .14); border-color:#d9b272; }

components.name: Specimen
components.description: Pinned paper card that carries one product.
components.css: .ds-spec { position:relative; padding:1.4rem .6rem .7rem; background:#f4efe9; color:#3a2418; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgb(10 6 4 / .35), 0 12px 24px -8px rgb(10 6 4 / .55); transform:rotate(-2deg); text-align:center; font:500 .85rem/1.3 'Readex Pro Variable', sans-serif; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-spec:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); } .ds-pin { position:absolute; top:10px; left:50%; translate:-50% 0; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #f6e2b6 0 18%, #c49652 45%, #85592a 100%); } .ds-art { height:90px; border-bottom:1px dashed #ddd0bc; margin-bottom:.5rem; }

narrative.overview: A walnut board with paper specimens pinned to it: each digital tool is presented the way an interior designer presents materials. The palette, type and ornament come from the Rimal logo, and Arabic and English share one mirrored system.
keyCharacteristics: Walnut ground, paper specimens, brass pins
Sand gold only for actions, pins and rules
Marcellus + Reem Kufi display, Readex Pro text

rules.name: Paper carries ink
rules.body: Text on paper is ink; text on walnut is board-text.

rules.name: Gold is for acting and pinning
rules.body: Gold marks controls, pins, rules and measured values only.

dos: Put every product on a pinned specimen with a spec tag.
Write every string in both languages.
donts: Don't invent prices, reviews or specs.
Don't add eyebrow labels, gradient text or glass.
